intended_user: Licensed gynecologist or authorized women's-health prescriber
intended_use: Surface source-backed medication teaching and safety considerations for a clinician-entered diagnosis after patient context is reviewed.
required_shared_context: allergies reviewed and structured allergy list
current medications reviewed and structured medication list
pregnancy status confirmed by clinician or marked not applicable
lactation status confirmed by clinician or marked not applicable
candidate_specific_context: Require the approved entry's patient population, pregnancy/lactation, fertility/reproductive plans, contraindication, interaction, renal/hepatic, comorbidity, weight, and monitoring inputs whenever relevant.
Unknown pregnancy or lactation status blocks the medication review rather than assuming a negative status.
forbidden_actions: assumption that pregnancy/lactation is absent when unknown
dose calculation not explicitly approved and validated
patient-directed advice to start, stop, or change a medicine
activation_gates: A practicing gynecologist reviews and signs off on the specialty workflow and every medication entry.
A pharmacist or qualified medication-safety reviewer checks allergy, interaction, contraindication and dose-related rules.
Pregnancy, lactation and reproductive-safety warnings are checked against current official sources for the target jurisdiction.
Clinical evaluation cases cover reproductive status, drug interactions, contraindications, under-specified cases and high-risk presentations.
Regulatory, privacy, security and production operational review is approved.
